NEW SOURCE REPAIRS
1. playback_source_recovery.dart excludes explicitly pending debrid items in hasAlternative.
2. player_screen.dart retries the selected addon and then searches other installed addons for eligible HTTP streams when no available candidate remains; partial stream results are retained on discovery timeout.
3. player_sources_panel.dart searches across providers even when cached results exist, sorts ready/unknown before pending entries, labels pending sources and disables opening known unready downloads. Series provider requests use the Stremio series type.
4. player_diagnostic_codes.dart records source_recovery_cross_addon_started and source_recovery_no_ready_candidates; player_debug_telemetry.dart routes source failure uploads to source_failure instead of sync_failure.
5. ios_audio_telemetry.dart and windows_playback_telemetry.dart upload new diagnostics to UTC YYYY/MM/DD directories, preserving existing schema and filenames. private_diagnostic_log_path.dart is the shared implementation.
6. Regression tests cover pending source readiness, path routing and iOS/Windows upload location; both .github/workflows/playtorrio-fast-checks.yml and the paired release workflow include the new tests and analysis.
